# Payment Form

A complete card-checkout block. The number, expiry and CVC are masked as you type, the card brand is detected live, and the billing country shows circular flags. Accept promo codes to roll the total.

```tsx
<PaymentForm
  amount="$49.00"
  promoCodes={{
    KOALA20: { percentOff: 20, label: "KOALA20 · 20% off" },
    WELCOME10: { amountOff: 10, label: "WELCOME10 · $10 off" },
  }}
  promoHint="Try KOALA20 for 20% off, or WELCOME10 for $10 off."
  onSubmit={(data) => pay(data)}
/>
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli add payment-form
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/payment-form/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
"use client"

import { PaymentForm, type PaymentFormData } from "@/components/ui/payment-form"

export function Example() {
  async function pay(data: PaymentFormData) {
    await fetch("/api/checkout", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(data) })
  }

  return (
    <PaymentForm
      amount="$49.00"
      promoCodes={{ WELCOME10: { amountOff: 10, label: "WELCOME10 · $10 off" } }}
      onSubmit={pay}
    />
  )
}
```

## API reference

### PaymentForm

Composes [Field](https://koala-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/field.md), [Input](https://koala-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/input.md), and [Select](https://koala-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/select.md). The masking and brand detection are presentation only; never store an unmasked card number. Forwards all `<div>` props.

- `amount`: display total (e.g. `"$49.00"`). Shows the summary row and labels the Pay button. When a code is applied, the shown total is the discounted one.
- `promoCodes`: `Record<string, PaymentPromoCode>` keyed by code (matched case-insensitively). Reveals the promo-code row; each code carries a `percentOff` and/or `amountOff` (and an optional `label`). Applying one drops in a subtotal → discount breakdown and rolls the total. Requires a parseable `amount`.
- `promoHint`: caption under the promo input (e.g. `"Try KOALA20"`).
- `defaultCountry`: billing country ISO2 (default `"US"`).
- `onSubmit`: `(data: PaymentFormData) => void | Promise<void>`, where `PaymentFormData` is `{ cardNumber, expiry, cvc, name, country, promoCode? }`.

## FAQ

### Does PaymentForm process payments or store card data?

No. The masking and live brand detection are presentation only, and PaymentForm never touches a network. Wire your `onSubmit` handler to a provider like Stripe, and never store the unmasked card number yourself.

### How do I run a loading spinner while the charge settles?

Return a promise from `onSubmit`. The form sets its internal status to loading (the Pay button shows a spinner) until the promise resolves, then flips to the built-in success screen.

### How do promo codes work?

Pass `promoCodes` as a map of code to a `{ percentOff?, amountOff?, label? }` discount. A "Promo code" field appears under the billing country; codes are matched case-insensitively. Applying a valid one slides a subtotal → discount breakdown into the summary and rolls the total to its new value, an invalid one shows an inline error, and the applied code arrives on `onSubmit` as `data.promoCode`. The discount math re-uses your `amount` string's currency symbol, decimals, and grouping.

### What shape is the data passed to onSubmit?

A `PaymentFormData` object with `cardNumber`, `expiry`, `cvc`, `name`, and `country` (ISO2). The card number, expiry, and CVC arrive masked exactly as displayed.

### How do I set the order total and the default billing country?

Pass `amount` as a preformatted string like `"$49.00"` to show the summary row and label the Pay button, and `defaultCountry` as an ISO2 code (default `"US"`) to preselect the CountrySelect.

### Why do the nested Inputs blend into the card instead of looking filled?

The card paints no fill of its own, so the composed Field, Input, and CountrySelect take the same ground the card sits on rather than a separate background block. The summary wells are the one filled part, and they declare their own `--surface`.

### Can I change the spacing to match a denser layout?

Set `density` to `compact` (16px, the default) or `comfortable` (24px). Omit it and the form inherits from the nearest DensityProvider.

## Exports and dependencies

`npx koalaui-cli add payment-form` writes `components/ui/payment-form/`. Import from `@/components/ui/payment-form`:

- Components and helpers: `PaymentForm`, `paymentFormVariants`
- Types: `PaymentFormProps`, `PaymentFormData`, `PaymentPromoCode`
- Koala components it installs with it: `button`, `field`, `form`, `input`
- Koala lib helpers it uses: `density`, `tv`, `utils`
- npm packages: `@phosphor-icons/react`
